content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 1: Python for Data Analysis: Basics and Setup
    - Lesson 2: Understanding Datasets and Data Structures in Python
    - Lesson 3: Reading, Writing, and Manipulating CSV Files
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Libraries: NumPy and Pandas
    - Lesson 5: Data Cleaning with Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Basic Data Visualization with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 7: Intermediate Data Visualization Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Working with Time Series Data
    - Lesson 9: Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to SQL for Data Analysis

   Track: Intermediate SQL (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 11: Joins, Unions, and Subqueries in SQL
    - Lesson 12: Advanced Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 13: Handling NULL Values and Complex Data Types
    - Lesson 14: Advanced Filtering Techniques with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 15: Creating and Managing Databases and Tables in SQL
    - Lesson 16: Stored Procedures and Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 17: Optimizing SQL Queries for Performance
    - Lesson 18: Introduction to Database Design Concepts (Normalization, Denormalization)

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preparation (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 19: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 20: Removing Duplicates and Outliers from Data
    - Lesson 21: Transforming and Aggregating Data for Analysis
    - Lesson 22: Merging, Appending, and Concatenating Datasets
    - Lesson 23: Handling Inconsistent or Incomplete Data
    - Lesson 24: Preparing Time Series Data for Analysis
    - Lesson 25: Creating Derived Columns and Feature Engineering

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 26: Descriptive Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 27: Correlation and Covariance Analysis
    - Lesson 28: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 29: Visualizing Distributions, Boxplots, and Scatterplots
    - Lesson 30: Clustering and Segmentation Techniques for Data Exploration

   Track: Data Storytelling with Excel (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 31: Creating Effective Tables and Charts in Excel
    - Lesson 32: Formatting and Styling Excel Workbooks for Presentations
    - Lesson 33: Using Conditional Formatting to Highlight Data Insights
    - Lesson 34: Creating Dashboards and Reports with Excel Power BI Integration
    - Lesson 35: Sharing and Collaborating on Data Analysis Workbooks

   Track: Introductory Statistics (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 36: Probability Theory and Distribution Basics
    - Lesson 37: Mean, Median, Mode, and Standard Deviation
    - Lesson 38: Central Limit Theorem and Sampling Distributions
    - Lesson 39: Hypothesis Testing for Means and Proportions
    - Lesson 40: Regression Analysis and Correlation Coefficient

   Track: Introduction to Power BI (Analyst Path)
    - Lesson 41: Creating a Basic Report in Power BI
    - Lesson 42: Data Modeling and Relationships in Power BI
    - Lesson 43: Visualizing Data with Power BI
    - Lesson 44: Interactive Dashboards and Real-time Updates in Power BI
    - Lesson 45: Sharing, Publishing, and Collaborating on Power BI Reports
